## Description
Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced in this Pull Request and which issue(s) it addresses.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature / preset (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization / refactor

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (`dart format .`).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`).
- [ ] I have added unit/widget tests that prove my fix or feature works (`flutter test`).
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed without errors.
- [ ] Static analysis reported zero errors and zero warnings (`flutter analyze`).
